finding.message: src/presentation/invoice.controller.ts (presentation) skips layers to import src/persistence/invoice.repository.ts (persistence)

answer.explanation: InvoiceController (presentation) imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository (persistence), and its cancel() method calls repo.markCancelled directly. This skips the business layer, so a state change (cancelling an invoice) bypasses InvoiceService. FF-S03 flags presentation reaching persistence directly. The README declares strict layering with no skipping, says a controller never imports a repository, and says every write goes through InvoiceService. The code does exactly what the README forbids. No doc or comment grants an exception.
